definitions.explanation: the function or act of reheating bath water that has cooled down, a common feature in Japanese bathrooms

examples.japanese: お{湯|ゆ}が{冷|さ}めたから{追|お}い{焚|だ}きする。
examples.english: The water got cold, so I'll reheat it.

examples.japanese: この{物件|ぶっけん}は{追|お}い{焚|だ}き{機能|きのう}がついている。
examples.english: This property has a bath reheating function.

examples.japanese: {追|お}い{焚|だ}きボタンを{押|お}せば10{分|ぷん}で{温|あたた}まる。
examples.english: Press the reheat button and it'll be warm in 10 minutes.

notes:
FORMATION:
{追|お}い (additional) + {焚|だ}き (heating, burning) → additional heating

VERB FORM:
{追|お}い{焚|だ}きする (to reheat bath water)

JAPANESE BATH CULTURE:
In Japan, families often share the same bath water, with each person bathing one after another. The {追|お}い{焚|だ}き function reheats the water so later bathers can enjoy a warm bath without refilling.

RELATED BATH CONTROLS:
- {給湯|きゅうとう} (hot water supply)
- {温度|おんど}{設定|せってい} (temperature setting)
- {自動|じどう}{保温|ほおん} (automatic temperature maintenance)

HOUSING NOTE:
When searching for apartments in Japan, {追|お}い{焚|だ}き{機能|きのう}{付|つ}き (with reheating function) is often listed as a desirable feature.

RELATED WORDS:
- {湯船|ゆぶね} / {浴槽|よくそう} (bathtub)
- {風呂釜|ふろがま} (bath boiler)
